item.title: Designing for Agents — Zeno Rocha, Resend
item.dc:creator: swyx .ai
item.description: Where does answer engine optimization (AEO) end and agent experience begin? Inside Resend, from the docs that help Claude Code pick an email API to the tools it uses to send.
item.content:encoded:
Today’s podcast comes from a real life mystery: We are big fans of Cloudflare’s developer platform, and Cloudflare Email is a convenient tool especially when all your domains are already on Cloudflare.

So why do agents keep suggesting we use Resend despite having an existing “home bias” and much larger incumbent player?

Well, we got the guy who “does AEO for resend” - the CEO of AEO, Zeno Rocha, who has been writing about AEO since 2024 and Agent Experience since Feb 2025, on the pod today:

item.title: NaiveAI Promises 2,100 Tokens per Second. How Well Does It Code?
item.dc:creator: Gabriele Beltramo
item.description: NaiveAI could potentially top Artificial Analysis’s speed rankings. Our hands-on test suggests its coding quality holds up against DeepSeek.
item.content:encoded:
Editor’s note: With this post, we are launching a new series focused on trying new models and products with unbiased reviews. Reach out with suggestions to tips@latent.space.

Naive-N0.5-Flash is a new open-weights model built for AI coding tasks and tuned to generate as many tokens per second as possible. It was developed by a Chinese company called NaiveAI, with the aim of speeding up engineering and research workflows so that teams can experiment, iterate and solve complex problems faster.

item.title: [AINews] Fable 5.2 retakes World #1 LLM spot as $ANT IPO roadshow begins
item.dc:creator: swyx .ai
item.description: November 9, 2026 — Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 arrive on Anthropic’s IPO roadshow day. How much thinking is worth paying for?
item.content:encoded:
On Friday, we asked Jamin Ball what comes next for Anthropic’s IPO. On Monday the roadshow started and Anthropic shipped the long-anticipated next-version of Claude Fable and Mythos. Of course, it is the new top model in the world, taking back Opus 5.5’s #1 spot from Gemini 4 Carbon which had its brief moment in the sun (10 days).
